items.value: The Wannabe artist who is usually jealous of anyone who has more notebooks than them, an easy target.
The 30 year old gum-spewing idiot that tries to impress others with his tricks, but always ends up spitting it out onto others.
The brute of the schoolhouse himself, stealing items and just being a jerk in general to people, might be a difficult person to remove.
The floating rat cloud that blows wind down hallways, probably one of the most annoying people here.
The sad excuse of a doctor that tries his best to be helpful, but is really good for reflexes only.
The nicest character in this school.
The broom that loves to do its own job, a respectable yet really annoying act.
I Don't know what this thing is, but I don't like them at all.
The other teacher here, not sure what she actually teaches though, extremely loud.
Are you seriously gonna make me beat up a kid?
I Will gladly get rid of him, he thinks he's genuinely in charge, but we both know he isn't.
Are you seriously going to make me beat up the only guy with a weapon?
I always trip over this guy, though i do wonder if its my own fault or not.
Not sure if i'll be able to get rid of this one as easy as the others honestly...
